prompt:
Turn the attached photo into a 1990s instant-film print that has been kept in a drawer for thirty years.

Keep the person, pose, framing and clothing exactly as they are.

Apply, in this order: a slight warm-magenta colour shift with lifted, milky blacks; visible film grain across the whole frame; soft focus that gets softer toward the edges; a faint yellow-orange light leak entering from the bottom-right corner and fading out by the middle of the frame; one small dust speck and one hairline scratch near the top-left. Slightly reduce contrast so highlights bloom.

Present it as the physical print: white instant-film border, wider at the bottom, sitting flat on a plain neutral surface, photographed straight on with soft even light. No handwriting on the border, no text anywhere.
